title: Wednesday Daily Practice
subtitle: Mixed practice: Lesson 7 words, -s and -es, find the mistake, write about a classmate
source: Foundation 11 lesson plan, week 5 (B7 Other people's habits, B8 Putting it all together + Phase A test), Wed 11 Nov (mixed practice)
intro: Six steps, about 60 minutes. Deadline: 23:00 the same day. Step 5 is writing: type it in the box on the website. Step 6 is a voice note.

steps.title: Step 1 · Lesson 7 words
steps.instructions: Fill in each gap with a Lesson 7 word. Change the form if needed (is, are, -s).

items.label: 1. My dad goes to bed at 2 a.m. He ____. (be a night owl)
2. The grass is very long. I ____ on Sunday morning. (mow the lawn)
3. She drinks five cups a day. She ____ coffee. (be addicted to)
4. Take a rest! If you work 14 hours a day, you ____. (burn out)
5. We get up at 5 a.m. every day. We ____. (be an early bird)
6. I sit quietly and ____ before work. (meditate)
7. Many students ____ on Saturday night and watch films. (stay up late)
8. Please ____ the plastic bottles. Don't throw them away. (recycle)
9. I am never hungry in the morning, so I often ____ breakfast. (skip)
10. On Sunday, she ____ until 10 a.m. (stay in bed)

steps.title: Step 2 · -s, -es, -ies
steps.instructions: Write the verb with he, she or it.

items.label: 1. She ____ TV at night. (watch)
2. He ____ to bed at 11. (go)
3. My sister ____ English. (study)
4. My brother ____ yoga. (do)
5. He ____ a shower at 7. (have)
6. She ____ the car on Saturday. (wash)
7. He ____ his bike. (fix)
8. My mum ____ new food. (try)

steps.title: Step 3 · Find the mistake
steps.instructions: Each sentence has one mistake. Write the correct sentence.

items.label: 1. She don't like tea.
2. He go to school at 7.

accept: He goes to school at seven.

items.label: 3. Does she works here?
4. My brother doesn't watchs TV.

accept: My brother does not watch TV.

items.label: 5. She haves a new bike.
6. How often he cooks?

steps.title: Step 4 · Web words from Tuesday
steps.instructions: Fill in each gap with one of Tuesday's 20 words on the website.

items.label: 1. He ____ old coins. He has 300 coins now. (c)
2. My uncle and I play ____ every week. (c)
3. She does a ____ in the newspaper every day. (c)
4. She is ____ in her book. She doesn't hear me. (a)
5. I feel ____ when the wifi is slow. (f)

steps.title: Step 5 · Writing: a classmate
steps.instructions: Write about 40 words about the habits of one classmate. Use he or she, 1 frequency adverb (always, usually, often, sometimes, never) and 1 sentence with doesn't. Type it in the box on the website.

open.model: My classmate Linh is a night owl. She usually stays up late and studies English. She doesn't skip breakfast. She goes to the gym twice a week. On Sunday, she stays in bed until nine.

ai.type: Short paragraph about a classmate's habits
ai.task: Write about 40 words about a classmate's habits with 1 frequency adverb and 1 sentence with doesn't.
criteria: he or she verbs with the correct -s / -es / -ies ending
1 correct sentence with doesn't + base verb
frequency adverb in the correct position

steps.title: Step 6 · Voice note
steps.instructions: Read the 6 correct sentences from Step 3 aloud. Record one voice note.
steps.note: Teacher listens for doesn't /ˈdʌznt/, goes /z/ and the rising tone in the questions.

send_today: Six steps on the website. Voice note in step 6 is sent to the teacher when you press Submit.
